about: The match memory's moments (sim/match-memory.js): turning points, duels, let-offs, the chase's equation and the phases of the game. Two sample lines for each voice; add more freely.

bunnings: THAT MAY BE THE BALL WE TALK ABOUT LATER.
THE MATCH HAS JUST LEANED. QUITE A LOT.
lorry: THAT COULD BE THE TURNING POINT! WHAT A MOMENT!
EVERYTHING JUST CHANGED! {team} WILL FEEL THAT!
grog: THAT SHIFTS THE BALANCE. {team} WERE {before} PER CENT, NOW {after}.
ONE BALL, AND THE PLANS ALL CHANGE.

bunnings: THIS STAND OF {stand} HAS QUIETLY MOVED THE MATCH.
{stand} TOGETHER. THE GAME LOOKS DIFFERENT NOW.
lorry: {stand} RUNS TOGETHER! THEY'VE TURNED THIS AROUND!
WHAT A PARTNERSHIP! {stand} OFF {balls}!
grog: {stand} OFF {balls} BALLS. THE BOWLERS NEED A NEW IDEA.
THIS PAIR HAS CHANGED THE SHAPE OF THE GAME.

bunnings: {w} HAS BEATEN {b} {beaten} TIMES NOW.
{b} AND {w}. ONE OF THEM IS ENJOYING THIS MORE.
lorry: BEATEN AGAIN! {w} HAS {b} ON A STRING!
{beaten} TIMES {w} HAS GONE PAST THE EDGE!
grog: {w} HAS FOUND {b}'S WEAK SPOT. {beaten} PLAYS AND MISSES.
SAME LINE, SAME RESULT. {w} WILL KEEP GOING THERE.

bunnings: {b} HAS {runs} OFF {w} FROM {balls} BALLS.
{w} MAY BE SEEING {b} IN HIS SLEEP.
lorry: {runs} OFF {balls} AGAINST {w}! {b} OWNS HIM!
{b} JUST LOVES FACING {w}!
grog: {runs} FROM {balls}. {w} NEEDS A DIFFERENT PLAN.
TIME TO TAKE {w} OFF AGAINST {b}, I'D SAY.

bunnings: {w} HAS HIM AGAIN. THAT'S {times} TIMES.
{b} WON'T BE SENDING {w} A CARD.
lorry: HE'S GOT HIM AGAIN! {times} TIMES THIS MATCH!
{w} HAS {b}'S NUMBER!
grog: {times} TIMES NOW. {w} KNOWS EXACTLY WHERE TO BOWL.
SAME BOWLER, SAME BATTER, SAME ENDING.

bunnings: {dots} DOTS IN A ROW FROM {w} TO {b}.
{b} HASN'T SCORED OFF {w} IN A WHILE.
lorry: {dots} DOTS! {w} IS SQUEEZING HIM!
NOTHING DOING! {b} CAN'T GET {w} AWAY!
grog: {dots} DOTS. {w} IS BUILDING THE PRESSURE NICELY.
{b} NEEDS TO ROTATE THE STRIKE AGAINST {w}.

bunnings: {b} WAS ON {droppedOn} AT {letoff}. HE'S {nowOn} NOW.
{letoff} HAS COST {cost} RUNS SO FAR.
lorry: {cost} RUNS SINCE {letoff}! THAT'S HURTING!
{b} WAS ON {droppedOn}! NOW HE'S {nowOn}!
grog: {letoff} ON {droppedOn}. {cost} RUNS LATER, IT MATTERS.
THAT'S {cost} SINCE {letoff}. CHANCES COST.

bunnings: THE RATE HAS CLIMBED PAST {threshold} AN OVER.
{need} OFF {left}. THE ASKING RATE IS {rrr}.
lorry: OVER {threshold} AN OVER NOW! THIS IS GETTING TIGHT!
THEY NEED {rrr} AN OVER! COME ON!
grog: {rrr} AN OVER. THEY CAN'T WAIT MUCH LONGER.
PAST {threshold} AN OVER. SOMEONE HAS TO GO.

bunnings: {runs} AFTER {over} OVERS. {diff} AHEAD OF THE PACE.
AFTER {over}, {team} ARE ON TRACK.
lorry: {diff} AHEAD OF THE RATE AFTER {over}! LOVELY STUFF!
{team} ARE WELL IN THIS AFTER {over} OVERS!
grog: {over} OVERS GONE, {runs} ON THE BOARD. GOOD PLATFORM.
AHEAD BY {diff}. NOW DON'T THROW IT AWAY.

bunnings: {runs} AFTER {over} OVERS. {diff} BEHIND THE PACE.
AFTER {over}, {team} HAVE WORK TO DO.
lorry: {diff} BEHIND AFTER {over}! THEY'VE GOT TO GO!
{team} ARE FALLING BEHIND! {over} OVERS GONE!
grog: {diff} BEHIND AT {over} OVERS. TIME TO ACCELERATE.
{runs} AFTER {over}. THE BACK END WILL BE BUSY.

bunnings: A BOUNDARY AN OVER NOW, OR THEY FALL BEHIND.
{rrr} AN OVER. SINGLES WON'T DO IT.
lorry: THEY NEED A BOUNDARY EVERY OVER! EVERY ONE!
{rrr} AN OVER! FIND THE ROPE!
grog: AT {rrr}, THEY NEED A FOUR EVERY OVER. {overs} LEFT.
SINGLES AND A BOUNDARY AN OVER. THAT'S THE PLAN.

bunnings: A NEW BALL AFTER {overs} OVERS. SHINY.
THE NEW BALL. THE BATTERS WILL NOTICE.
lorry: NEW BALL! HERE COMES THE SWING!
THE NEW BALL'S HERE! LOOK OUT!
grog: NEW BALL. EXPECT THE QUICKS AND A SLIP OR TWO.
IT'LL COME ON QUICKER NOW. NEW BALL.

bunnings: THE OLD BALL HAS STARTED TO REVERSE.
{overs} OVERS OLD, AND GOING THE OTHER WAY.
lorry: IT'S REVERSING! THE OLD BALL IS TALKING!
REVERSE SWING! THIS COULD GET LIVELY!
grog: REVERSE SWING NOW. FULL AND STRAIGHT IS THE PLAN.
ONE SIDE ROUGH, ONE SIDE SHINY. IT'S REVERSING.

bunnings: THE PITCH HAS STARTED TO TURN.
SOME DUST ABOUT NOW. THE SPINNERS WILL SMILE.
lorry: IT'S TURNING NOW! SPINNERS' TIME!
LOOK AT THAT GRIP! THE PITCH IS BREAKING UP!
grog: THE SURFACE IS WEARING. SPIN FROM BOTH ENDS, I'D SAY.
IT'S TURNING. GET THE SPINNER ON.

bunnings: {runs} FOR {wkts} FROM THE POWERPLAY.
THE POWERPLAY ENDS. THE FIELD SPREADS.
lorry: {runs} FOR {wkts} IN THE POWERPLAY! WHAT A START!
POWERPLAY DONE! NOW IT GETS HARDER!
grog: {runs} FOR {wkts} AFTER {overs}. NOW FOR THE MIDDLE OVERS.
FIELDERS BACK. SINGLES ARE THE CURRENCY NOW.

bunnings: WE'RE INTO {light} NOW.
THE LIGHT HAS CHANGED. SO MIGHT THE CRICKET.
lorry: {light}! WHAT A SIGHT!
AND NOW {light}! LOVELY!
grog: {light}. THE BALL CAN DO MORE NOW.
A CHANGE OF LIGHT. HARDER TO PICK UP OFF THE HAND.

bunnings: THE LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}.
ONE MORE OVER, THEN {brk}.
lorry: LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}! DON'T GET OUT NOW!
ONE MORE BEFORE {brk}! HANG ON!
grog: LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}. A WICKET NOW WOULD BE GOLD.
BATTERS JUST WANT TO SEE THIS ONE OUT BEFORE {brk}.
